source_text: Similarly, the World Health Organization (WHO) endorses voluntary medical male circumcision (VMMC) as part of HIV prevention strategies in high-prevalence regions, particularly sub-Saharan Africa, where over 30 million procedures have been performed since 2007, averting an estimated 615,000 HIV infections by 2020 based on modeling of randomized trial data. [38]
